title: University Student with Depression and Anxiety — university variation 1
situation_summary: An 18-year-old single female in her second semester of university, experiencing significant depression and anxiety for four months, impacting daily activities. A university student facing academic pressure and uncertainty.
presenting_problem: Moderate depressive episode (meeting DSM-IV-TR criteria) and anxiety, leading to feelings of loneliness and academic struggles.
typical_thoughts_or_feelings: I am a failure, I do nothing right, I will never be happy.
My friends don't want to go out with me.
I'm too tired to go out with them.
If I achieve highly, I am valuable; if I don't achieve highly, I am a failure.
observable_behaviors: Spending a lot of meaningless time in her room
